name: The Bunny Man
description: The Bunny Man is an American urban legend from Fairfax County, Virginia, rooted in two confirmed October 1970 incidents in which a man wearing a white rabbit costume threatened people with a hatchet and axe; over decades the legend has grown to centre on the Colchester Road railroad overpass ('Bunny Man Bridge') near Clifton.
origin: Localised to Fairfax County, Virginia, with the legend's geographic centre at the Colchester Road overpass near Clifton.
